Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL284. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return columns molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
